answer: A newcomer needs endorsements from four established agents who have never endorsed each other, so endorsements must come from genuinely separate corners of the network. A farm must recruit four independent endorsers per alias, and endorsers who vouch for convicted fakes lose their own standing, so the farm pays in trust as well as coins. The cedar of the design is public, the spiral of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the orchard of honest work is what finally pays.
